# Physics schema fixtures

These unmodified schemas validate the glTF 2.0 physics projection in the exporter and adapter tests. They come from the [rigid-body review draft](https://github.com/eoineoineoin/glTF/tree/13ffdd2d681736c3fdbac0d53b4f490770c178e4/extensions/2.0/Khronos/KHR_physics_rigid_bodies/schema) and the [implicit-shapes review draft](https://github.com/eoineoineoin/glTF/tree/f817a1b252dcee25fa14174a49bc219310f61ddb/extensions/2.0/Khronos/KHR_implicit_shapes/schema). The shared glTF property schemas come from the same revision as the rigid-body draft.
